subject.title: fix(sessions): prevent maintenance from deleting active sessions

question: Should this protected session-lifecycle PR proceed only after inspectable live cron proof is attached, or is the detailed PR-body description sufficient for maintainer acceptance?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but this external PR changes shared session-state concurrency and the repository requires real after-fix evidence; the maintainer label also requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Require inspectable proof
options.body: Ask for redacted before/after terminal output or logs, refresh onto current main, and approve if exact-head review and checks remain clean.

options.title: Accept described proof
options.body: A lifecycle owner may explicitly accept the detailed live-run description after independently reviewing the refreshed merge result.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted before/after terminal output or logs, refresh onto current main, and approve if exact-head review and checks remain clean.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the automatic maintenance and session-store lifecycle boundaries most affected by the proof and merge decision.
